description: Bytebeat player: a short C-style expression in a counter variable is evaluated once per step and the result, masked to a chosen number of bits, becomes the output voltage

params.text: Sets how fast the counter steps, 16Hz at fully counter-clockwise to about 22kHz at fully clockwise, coming up at 8000Hz; with a cable in the CLOCK jack it becomes a multiplier of that clock
Starts and stops the counter; while it is stopped the output holds at 0V
Sets the counter back to zero without stopping it
Sets the value the letter a stands for in the expression, a whole number from 0 to 128
Sets the value the letter b stands for in the expression, a whole number from 0 to 128
Sets the value the letter c stands for in the expression, a whole number from 0 to 128
Sets how many bits of the result are kept, 1 to 12, which is what makes the steps in the output coarse or fine
Attenuates the CV a jack, 0 to 1; at 0 that jack does nothing
Attenuates the CV b jack, 0 to 1; at 0 that jack does nothing
Attenuates the CV c jack, 0 to 1; at 0 that jack does nothing

inputs.text: Scaled so that 10V is the full 128, multiplied by its attenuator and added to the a knob, the total clamped to 128
Scaled so that 10V is the full 128, multiplied by its attenuator and added to the b knob, the total clamped to 128
Scaled so that 10V is the full 128, multiplied by its attenuator and added to the c knob, the total clamped to 128
Each rise past 2V starts or stops the counter, the same flip the RUN button makes
Each rise past 2V sets the counter back to zero
Sets the base rate from the time between its own rises, and the FREQ knob then multiplies that; with no cable the base rate is 2Hz

outputs.text: The value of the expression, scaled onto whichever range the menu is set to and 0V while the counter is stopped

notes: the module puts out 0V until an expression is typed into the display and submitted with the Enter key; nothing on the panel does anything before that
the two lamps report on the expression: one lights while the text has been changed but not submitted, the other while the submitted text could not be parsed
the editor is a plain text field rather than a control, so clicking it cannot reach a help line
every jack is monophonic, whatever is patched in
menu: Output Range: -2.5V..2.5V, -5V..5V, 0..5V, 0..10V — sets the span the expression's result is scaled onto
Submit/New Line: Enter/Shift+Enter, Shift+Enter/Enter — swaps which key submits the expression and which starts a new line in the editor

inputs.0:
0 to 10V · continuous · one channel only

unpatched it reads 0V; a negative voltage subtracts from the knob; the knob and this input are summed and the total held to 0 to 10V.
inputs.1:
0 to 10V · continuous · one channel only

unpatched it reads 0V; a negative voltage subtracts from the knob; the knob and this input are summed and the total held to 0 to 10V.

0 to 10V · continuous · one channel only

unpatched it reads 0V; a negative voltage subtracts from the knob; the knob and this input are summed and the total held to 0 to 10V.
inputs.3: high above 2V · stepped · one channel only
inputs.4: high above 2V · stepped · one channel only
inputs.5:
high above 2V · stepped · one channel only

unpatched it reads 2Hz.
